en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a socialist‑era residential area with many mid‑rise apartment blocks. In the right background a large circular domed building (Bucharest State Circus) is visible among trees. The reverse carries Romanian text, a 40‑bani R.P. ROMÎNĂ stamp, Bucharest postmarks, and a printed caption identifying the view as the Floreasca residential quarter.
